title: Stable Cohomotopy in Codimensions Two and Three: From Algebraic Characterizations to Bordism-Theoretic Interpretations
summary: This paper investigates stable cohomotopy groups in codimensions two and three from complementary algebraic and geometric viewpoints. For general CW complexes, we give a complete characterization of stable cohomotopy in codimension two and a characterization in codimension three up to a $3$-primary parameter. Geometrically, we provide bordism-theoretic interpretations of these stable cohomotopy groups for oriented manifolds in codimension two and string manifolds in codimension three.
